panels.title: Due, not yet sent
panels.description: Pending jobs whose time has come. The push tick runs every few seconds, so this should hover near 0.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "due" FROM push_jobs WHERE status = 'pending' AND fire_at <= now() AND available_at <= now() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})

panels.title: Oldest due job
panels.description: How late the most overdue pending job is. Climbing means the push tick is stuck or not running.

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(extract(epoch FROM now() - min(fire_at)), 0) AS "age" FROM push_jobs WHERE status = 'pending' AND fire_at <= now() AND available_at <= now() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})

panels.title: Scheduled
panels.description: Pending jobs set to fire later.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "scheduled" FROM push_jobs WHERE status = 'pending' AND fire_at > now() AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})

panels.title: Stuck processing
panels.description: Jobs claimed more than 5 minutes ago (push_job_stale_lock_minutes) and never finished.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "stuck" FROM push_jobs WHERE status = 'processing' AND locked_at < now() - interval '5 minutes' AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
SELECT count(*) AS "failed" FROM push_jobs WHERE status IN ('failed', 'partial_failed') AND $__timeFilter(updated_at) AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
SELECT count(*) AS "sent" FROM push_jobs WHERE status = 'sent' AND $__timeFilter(sent_at) AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})

panels.title: Job outcomes per hour
panels.description: Jobs by the hour they finished. Finished jobs (and their deliveries) are pruned after push_job_retention_days, 7 by default.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(updated_at, '1h', 0), status AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM push_jobs
WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at) AND status IN ('sent', 'partial_failed', 'failed', 'cancelled') AND channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Deliveries per hour
panels.description: One delivery per device token a job went to, by APNs / FCM and outcome. Finished jobs (and their deliveries) are pruned after push_job_retention_days, 7 by default.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(d.updated_at, '1h', 0), d.provider || ' ' || d.status AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM push_deliveries d
JOIN push_jobs j ON j.id = d.push_job_id
WHERE $__timeFilter(d.updated_at) AND d.status <> 'pending'
  AND d.provider IN (${provider:sqlstring}) AND j.channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Queue
panels.description: Rows in push_jobs by status, sampled every 30 seconds. Finished jobs (and their deliveries) are pruned after push_job_retention_days, 7 by default.

panels.title: Due backlog
panels.description: Both should sit at zero apart from brief blips.

panels.title: APNs / FCM send time, p95
panels.description: From the backend's own metrics: how long a single send to Apple or Google takes.

panels.title: APNs / FCM sends / s by outcome
Jobs by channel
panels.description: Every job currently in the table. Finished jobs (and their deliveries) are pruned after push_job_retention_days, 7 by default.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT channel AS "channel",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'pending') AS "pending",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'processing') AS "processing",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'sent') AS "sent",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'partial_failed') AS "partial failed",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'failed') AS "failed",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'cancelled') AS "cancelled"
FROM push_jobs
WHERE channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
GROUP BY channel
ORDER BY channel

SELECT channel AS "channel", scenario AS "scenario", count(*) AS "jobs",
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('failed', 'partial_failed')) AS "failed",
       max(updated_at) AS "last activity"
FROM push_jobs
WHERE channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 3 DESC

panels.title: Delivery failures
panels.description: Failed deliveries in the time range, by provider and failure code.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT provider AS "provider", token_kind AS "token", COALESCE(failure_code, '-') AS "code",
       count(*) AS "count", max(updated_at) AS "last seen"
FROM push_deliveries
WHERE status = 'failed' AND $__timeFilter(updated_at) AND provider IN (${provider:sqlstring})
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY "count" DESC

panels.title: Custom pushes
panels.description: Operator pushes sent from the portal's Custom push page.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT created_at AS "sent", title AS "title", kind AS "kind", target_classes AS "targets", total AS "devices"
FROM custom_push_sends
WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at)
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT j.updated_at AS "updated", j.id AS "id", COALESCE(u.student_id, j.user_id::text) AS "student",
       j.channel AS "channel", j.scenario AS "scenario", j.status AS "status",
       j.attempts || '/' || j.max_attempts AS "attempts", left(j.last_error, 300) AS "last error"
FROM push_jobs j
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = j.user_id
WHERE j.status IN ('failed', 'partial_failed') AND j.channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
  AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR concat_ws(' ', u.student_id, j.scenario, j.last_error) ILIKE '%' || ${search:sqlstring} || '%')
ORDER BY j.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Due but not sent
panels.description: The jobs behind 'Due, not yet sent', most overdue first.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT j.id AS "id", COALESCE(u.student_id, j.user_id::text) AS "student", j.channel AS "channel",
       j.scenario AS "scenario", j.fire_at AS "fire at", j.available_at AS "available at",
       j.attempts || '/' || j.max_attempts AS "attempts", j.priority AS "priority",
       left(j.last_error, 200) AS "last error"
FROM push_jobs j
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = j.user_id
WHERE j.status = 'pending' AND j.fire_at <= now() AND j.available_at <= now() AND j.channel IN (${channel:sqlstring})
ORDER BY j.fire_at
LIMIT 100
